---
name: Example request or contribution
about: Request a worked example for a specific situation, or propose one
title: "[EXAMPLE] "
labels: example
---

## Situation

The situation the example would cover. Could be a language or
ecosystem not currently represented (Go, .NET, Python, TypeScript),
a deployment pattern (event-driven, serverless, data pipeline),
or a specific decision scenario (a consolidation, a complex
extraction, a brownfield adoption).

## Why it would be useful

Who would benefit from this example. If you are requesting it,
what you have tried to adapt from the existing material and
where the adaptation got stuck.

## If you are contributing

If you have applied MODULE to a real or realistic situation and
want to write it up, describe briefly what you would cover. The
existing payments-domain example can be used as a structural
reference for the shape of the contribution.

Case studies, including ones where the framework did not fit
cleanly, are particularly welcome.
